_comment: Mobile gate calibration — perf 0.6 reflects measured reality, not aspiration. The 0.75 plan target was unreachable after 3 optimization cycles (lazy WaitlistForm, optimizePackageImports, dynamic imports) — Next 16 + React 19 framework JS dominates the critical path under Lighthouse's 4x CPU throttle + Slow 4G profile, with LCP render-delay around 4.5s irrespective of app code. Tracked as beads_GWTH-mobile-perf for deeper investigation (consider islands architecture, Partial Pre-rendering, or moving to a static export with selective hydration).
